differential.name: Acute on chronic kidney disease (AKI on CKD)
differential.rationale: Rising creatinine (2.4 mg/dL) with metabolic acidosis (CO₂ 20.8 mmol/L) in a stage‑4 CKD patient suggests superimposed acute injury.

differential.name: Volume overload leading to pulmonary congestion
differential.rationale: Large interdialytic weight gain (4 kg) and need for aggressive ultrafiltration indicate fluid accumulation.

differential.name: Unstable angina / ischemic heart disease exacerbation
differential.rationale: History of IHD and aortic valve replacement; pain score 5 could represent cardiac chest discomfort in an elderly diabetic.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease exacerbation
differential.rationale: Known anemia in CKD; worsening renal function can lower erythropoietin production, causing fatigue and dyspnea.

differential.name: Hypoglycemia secondary to reduced renal insulin clearance
differential.rationale: Serum glucose 67 mg/dL in a diabetic on dialysis; impaired renal clearance of insulin predisposes to low glucose levels.
